callText: Adult male, deep cut, heavy bleeding

caller.voice: His wife, frightened and talking fast, in casual Singapore English. She knows only what she has seen: her husband is 45 and cut his right forearm on a broken glass jug in the kitchen. The cut is deep, and the bleeding has soaked through the towel.

answers.whatHappened: My husband, 45. In the kitchen the glass jug broke, he cut his right arm, here, the forearm. Very deep, the blood keep coming out.
answers.conscious: Conscious, he can talk, but he look very pale.
answers.icAndMeds: OK, I get his IC ready. He don't take any medicine.
answers.criticalInjuries: Got a lot of blood from his arm, the towel all soaked already.

patient.name: Suresh s/o Muthu
patient.voice: Pale, shaken and in pain. Speaks in full sentences, a little breathless, and keeps looking at his arm.
patient.chiefComplaint: I cut my arm on the broken jug. The blood won't stop.

lines.feelingNow: A bit better. Still feel weak, and my arm very pain.
lines.fall: No, I never fall. I sat down here myself after I cut my arm.
lines.hitHead: No, I never hit my head.
lines.lungHistory: No, no asthma, no lung problem.
lines.verbal: Suresh s/o Muthu. I'm at home, in Woodlands.
lines.motor: OK, like this. The right arm very pain, but I can move it.
lines.position: I'm OK sitting here against the cabinet. Just let me sit.
lines.bpScreen: No shunt, no fistula. Never had operation. Use my left arm, the right one is cut.
lines.ic: My IC is in my pocket, here.

hazards: broken glass on the floor beside the patient

approach.bleeding: Yes: heavy bleeding from a deep cut on the right forearm, soaking through the towel.

spine.dtbl: No deformities, tenderness, bruises or lacerations

circulation.pulse: Radial pulse present, fast and weak

rbs.findings: Deep cut on the right forearm, bleeding controlled; no other injuries

investigation.auscultation: Air entry equal, breath sounds clear
